source_construct: PROC LOGISTIC descending, selection=stepwise slentry=0.05 slstay=0.05
target_translation: sas_compat.stepwise_logistic over the 36 candidates in MODEL statement order (train.sas:51-80): (1) intercept-only start; after every step, test REMOVAL first, then ENTRY. (2) REMOVAL: Wald chi-square for each effect in the model; remove the one with the SMALLEST chi-square if its p > 0.05 (ties: first in MODEL order), one per step. (3) ENTRY: for each candidate not in the model, in MODEL order, skip it if it is aliased with the CURRENT model (relative residual V / (z'Wz) < 1e-8, where V is its residual variance after projecting on the model's columns in the information metric; decided per step, never by pre-excluding columns: on this data only flag_serious_delinquency, identical to has_serious_delinquency, is skipped, from step 5); else compute the score chi-square U^2/V at the current fit; enter the LARGEST chi-square (DF=1; strict >, so equal chi-squares go to the FIRST in MODEL order; never select by smallest p, which underflows) if its p < 0.05. (4) Stop when nothing enters or the best entry is the effect just removed. Newton to max|step| < 1e-10 at every step. TODO(port): if an effect with an alias outside the model were ever removed, the alias could enter next and the two could alternate; unreachable on this data
evidence: train.sas:48-95; path in judge/reference/stepwise_summary.csv (24 steps; removals at 17, 21, 24); termination NOTE judge/reference/listings/train.sas.lst:1026 'No (additional) effects met the 0.05 significance level for entry'; VERIFIED by implementation: migration/experiments/x02_stepwise_reference.py (+ .out) reproduces all 24 EffectEntered/EffectRemoved of judge/reference/stepwise_summary.csv, step-1 score 14471.4043 exactly, other chi-squares within 3.4e-5 relative, stop after step 24 (best = num_credit_lines, just removed, p = 0.0512), residual chi-square 53.5194 on 15 DF vs SAS 53.5184 on 15 DF (lst ~1017); tie-break is load-bearing: at step 4 has_serious_delinquency and flag_serious_delinquency have bitwise-equal score 294.625 and SAS enters the first in MODEL order; aliased residual <= 7e-15 relative vs smallest non-aliased 1.3e-3, so any threshold in [1e-12, 1e-4] gives the same path; sites S093,S094
